dataset_obj.preview_note: A dataset is an object, not a path in a chat message: it carries its own identity, quality, lineage, and the list of runs that read it.
dataset_obj.quality_sub: A quick heuristic read of the data itself — not a full QC run. For real QC, use Run full QC.
dataset_obj.quality_noref: No resolvable reference — a data profile is not available for this dataset.
dataset_obj.quality_error: Profile not available — the profiler could not read this dataset.
dataset_obj.run_qc_tip: Run a full QC workflow on this dataset (e.g. FastQC + MultiQC) through BioMate and open its report
dataset_obj.qc_request: Run quality control (QC) on this dataset and generate a QC report.
dataset_obj.open_run: Open the run that produced it →
dataset_obj.lineage_note: This dataset was written by a workflow run; the run is an object you can open, not a string in a description.
dataset_obj.lineage_note_noprov: This dataset was written by a workflow run; live provenance is no longer retained for this run.
dataset_obj.uploaded_input: Uploaded input — no upstream workflow produced this dataset.
dataset_obj.no_consumers: No runs are recorded as reading this dataset yet.
dataset_obj.consumers_note: When consumers are recorded, replacing a dataset becomes a decision with a visible blast radius rather than a silent change under a running analysis.
dataset_obj.no_versions: Version history is not available yet — only the current dataset is recorded.
dataset_obj.version_note_help: Version entries are append-only — a note records a re-derivation or sign-off without ever rewriting a prior entry.
dataset_obj.columns_future: Per-column profiling (type, % missing, distinct) is coming. For now, open the file in Jupyter or ask in chat to inspect columns.
dataset_obj.plot_future: No distributions to plot inline yet. Open the file in Jupyter/RStudio or ask in chat for a specific view.
dataset_obj.plot_sample_caveat: Distribution of {{col}} across the {{n}}-row sample — open in Jupyter/RStudio for the full dataset.
dataset_obj.why_versions_body: A run records the exact version it consumed, so editing a file cannot change what a finished run means — and if a result looks wrong, you can see whether the input moved under it.
dataset_obj.one_version_only: Only one version of this file exists. Editing it, or a run writing to it, creates the next one.
dataset_obj.no_preview: No preview captured for this file yet.
dataset_obj.col_watch_missing: Over 20% of the sampled values are missing.
dataset_obj.columns_not_tabular: This file isn't a table, so there are no columns to profile. Open it in Jupyter or ask in chat to inspect it.
dataset_obj.open_as_dataset_title: Open the dataset object — preview, versions and lineage — in Files
dataset_obj.dedup_note: same bytes link to one entry
dataset_obj.open_in_title: Stage this file into a Galaxy history and open it in {{tool}}
dataset_obj.open_in_failed: Could not open the interactive tool
dataset_obj.diff_nontabular: Non-tabular file — current {{b}} B vs this version {{a}} B.
dataset_obj.edit_hint: Edit the first {{n}} sampled rows; saving applies your changes to the full file as a new version.

dataset_obj.rows_scope_partial: Sorting and filtering apply to the loaded rows only; scroll or load all rows to include the rest.
dataset_obj.rows_scope_full: Sorting and filtering apply to all rows.
dataset_obj.columns_loaded_note: Computed on the {{n}} loaded rows of {{total}}. Load all rows for whole-file statistics.
dataset_obj.preview_unsupported: Content preview is not available for this format. Download the file to open it in a compatible application.
dataset_obj.preview_truncated: Showing the first 256 KiB. Download for the complete file.
dataset_obj.preview_gz_unavailable: This browser cannot decompress files for preview. Download the file to open it, or use a current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
dataset_obj.preview_gz_corrupt: The compressed file could not be decoded for preview. Download it to check the file.
dataset_obj.preview_truncated_gz: Showing the beginning of the decompressed file. Download for the complete file.
dataset_obj.preview_tiff: TIFF images cannot be displayed in the browser. Download the file to open it in an image viewer (e.g. Fiji/ImageJ).
dataset_obj.record_hint: Click a row to open the record.

dataset_obj.edit_conflict: Not saved: the file changed, or a cell no longer holds the value shown. Reload and edit again.

diag.title: AI diagnosis
diag.no_log: No error log was captured for this run. If resuming keeps failing, report the run to BioMate.
diag.advice_resume: Resume from last step to reuse completed work.
diag.advice_no_resume: No completed step is available to resume. Review the error and restart after correcting the cause.
diag.advice_fix: Adjust your parameters or input files, then run again with edits.
diag.advice_check_input: Check your input data and parameters against the error, then run again.
diag.cat_infra_transient: A temporary infrastructure interruption stopped the run.
diag.cat_resource_memory: A step ran out of memory. Running it again with more memory should let it finish.
diag.cat_resource_time: The run hit its time limit. Running it again with a longer limit should let it finish.
diag.cat_config_param: A configuration or parameter issue stopped the run before it could complete.
diag.cat_input_data: An input was missing, could not be found, or looks malformed.
diag.cat_tool_error_detail: The step stopped with an error from the tool itself: {{detail}}
diag.cat_workflow_code: This looks like a defect in the workflow itself, not your input. A plain re-run would hit the same error; it has been flagged for the BioMate team.

perception.title: What we saw in your data
perception.effn_hint_dedup: Lower than the row count: {{dup}} duplicate rows are counted once.
perception.effn_hint_imbalance: Lower than the row count: bounded by the smallest class (class imbalance).
perception.effn_hint_correlation: Lower than the row count: correlated samples are discounted.
perception.why_unspecified: The profiler did not report a specific reason.

msg.file_not_found: The file could not be found.
msg.unprofilable: This file type cannot be profiled ({{name}}); only its shape is reported, no leakage or balance checks.
msg.parse_failed: The file could not be parsed: {{error}}
msg.unresolvable_ref: The dataset reference could not be resolved to a readable file.
msg.structured_too_large: Structural validation is limited to files under 2 million characters; download the file for a complete check.
msg.structured_only: Valid {{format}} syntax ({{root}} root). Only the structure was checked; scientific quality has not been assessed.
msg.fastq_reads: {{prefix}}{{reads}} reads scanned; mean read length {{mean_len}} bp.
msg.fastq_single_file: A single FASTQ file was profiled — treated as single-end unless a mate file is present.
msg.fastq_single_end_effect: single-end pipeline suggested (override if a paired mate exists)
msg.fastq_low_quality: Mean base quality Phred {{q}} is below 20 — consider trimming.
msg.fastq_no_records: No FASTQ records could be parsed — the file may be malformed.
msg.vcf_summary: VCF with {{variants}} variants and {{samples}} genotyped sample(s).
msg.vcf_no_variants: No variant records were found (header only).
msg.vcf_sized_effect: variant annotation and filtering plan sized accordingly
msg.no_columns: No columns could be parsed from the table.
msg.header_only: A header is present but there are no data rows yet.
msg.near_constant: {{count}} column(s) are near-constant (over {{pct}}% a single value): {{columns}}.
msg.high_missing: {{count}} column(s) have at least {{pct}}% missing values: {{columns}}.
msg.label_spellings: Two spellings of the same label: “{{a}}” and “{{b}}”.
msg.minority_class: Class “{{label}}” is only {{pct}}% of rows — consider a balanced sampler.
msg.effective_n_imbalance: Effective N ({{n}}) is far below the {{rows}} rows — bounded by the minority class under strong imbalance.
msg.effective_n_dedup: Effective N ({{n}}) is below the {{rows}} rows — {{duplicates}} duplicate row(s) reduce the independent samples.
msg.label_free_text: Column “{{column}}” looks like a label but has {{distinct}} distinct values — treated as free text, not a class target.
msg.table_clean: {{rows}} rows × {{cols}} columns; no leakage, imbalance or constant-column issues detected.
msg.profiled_subset: Statistics were computed on the first {{profiled}} of {{rows}} rows.
msg.leaked_id: Column “{{column}}” is (nearly) unique per row and perfectly predicts the label — a leaked identifier.
msg.leaked_feature: Column “{{column}}” predicts the label with {{pct}}% accuracy — the target has leaked into the features.
msg.batch_confound: “{{column}}” (batch/ID) is (nearly) perfectly correlated with the outcome label.
msg.batch_covariate_effect: add “{{column}}” as a covariate before modelling
msg.split_overlap: {{count}} feature row(s) appear in more than one split — train/test overlap.
msg.dedup_splits_effect: de-duplicate rows across splits before evaluation
msg.nested_tables: Column “{{column}}”: {{tables}} embedded tables, median {{median_rows}} rows × {{median_cols}} columns (largest {{max_rows}} rows).
msg.nested_row_cap: {{pct}}% of the tables in column “{{column}}” have exactly {{max_rows}} rows, the maximum: they were probably cut off when extracted. Check the extraction before analysing them.
msg.nested_blank_cells: {{pct}}% of the cells in the tables of column “{{column}}” are blank — typical of merged or multi-line cells in extracted tables; join continuation rows before analysis.
msg.columns_generated: No header row detected (line 1 holds data values); columns are named column_1 … column_{{count}}.
msg.columns_spec: {{format}} files have no header row; column names follow the {{format}} specification: {{columns}}.
msg.columns_comment: Column names taken from the file's last “#” comment line: {{columns}}.
msg.spec_mismatch: Named as {{format}}, but its content does not follow the {{format}} format, so it was not read as one.
msg.intervals_unstranded: No strand column: the intervals are treated as unstranded.
msg.annotation_features: {{features}} feature lines and {{comments}} comment lines; {{count}} attribute keys: {{attributes}}.
msg.mtx_bad_header: Not a readable Matrix Market file: the %%MatrixMarket banner or the size line is missing.
msg.mtx_dimensions: {{rows}} × {{cols}} sparse matrix ({{field}}) with {{nnz}} stored entries ({{density}}% non-zero).
msg.mtx_orientation: Matrix Market files carry no row or column names: pair this matrix with its features and barcodes files (10x: rows are features, columns are cells).
msg.format_metadata_only: {{format}} metadata was read; the data values themselves have not been analysed.
msg.format_identified: Identified as {{format}} ({{size}}); its contents are not analysed here.
msg.format_metadata_skipped: {{format}} metadata was not read: the file ({{size}}) is above the {{cap}} limit for reading during upload.
msg.format_header_unreadable: The {{format}} header could not be read ({{error}}); the file may be truncated or malformed.
msg.fasta_sequences: {{prefix}}{{sequences}} sequences, {{total}} {{unit}} in total; length mean {{mean}}, min {{min}}, max {{max}}, N50 {{n50}}.
msg.alignment_references: {{references}} reference sequences in the header ({{length}} bp).
msg.alignment_not_coordinate_sorted: Sort order is “{{order}}”, not coordinate: sort the file before indexing or variant calling.
msg.alignment_no_read_groups: No read groups (@RG) in the header: GATK and most variant callers require them.
msg.spreadsheet_convert: Spreadsheets are not checked cell by cell: export the sheet to CSV to get the table checks.
msg.fasta_high_n: {{pct}}% of bases are N (unknown): gaps or a low-quality assembly.
msg.fasta_orphan_lines: {{count}} sequence lines before the first “>” header were ignored.
msg.fasta_profiled_subset: Statistics cover the first {{mb}} MB of the file.

no_error.next: No error message was captured for this run. Open the run in the workflow panel → failed step → log to see the task log, and share it so I can investigate.

unknown.next: Share this error with me and I will investigate; the full task log is in the workflow panel → failed step → log.
unknown.next_step: Share this error with me and I will investigate; you can also open the run in the workflow panel → '{{process}}' step → log for the full task log.

workflow_not_found.cause: The workflow itself could not be loaded on the server — the pipeline path it was given does not exist or is unavailable.
workflow_not_found.next: Pick the workflow from the panel/catalog (or ask me to route your request) instead of that path, then run it again.

bad_contrast.cause: Your contrasts file references a column that is not present in your sample sheet, so the comparison could not be set up.
bad_contrast.cause_named: Your contrasts/design references the column '{{contrast}}', which is not in your sample sheet.
bad_contrast.next: Make the contrast variable match a column that exists in the sample sheet (add the column, or fix its name/spelling), then run again.
bad_contrast.next_named: Make the contrast variable match a column that exists in the sample sheet (add the column, or fix its name/spelling), then run again.

missing_column.cause_named: The analysis expected a column '{{column}}' that is not in your input table.
missing_column.next_named: Add the '{{column}}' column to your input (or correct the column name in the parameter that selects it), then run again.

too_few_rows.cause_named: The input table has only {{rows}} usable row(s), too few for {{folds}}-fold cross-validation — it does not look like a training table (one row per sample with feature columns and a label).
too_few_rows.next_named: Pick a dataset with one row per sample (at least a few dozen rows), or lower the number of folds / use a holdout split, then train again.

empty_input.cause: One of the input files is empty — there was no data for the step to process.
empty_input.cause_named: The input file {{file}} is empty — there was no data for the step to process.
empty_input.next: Confirm the upload/transfer completed and the file actually contains data, replace the empty input, then run again.
empty_input.next_named: Confirm the upload/transfer completed and the file actually contains data, replace the empty input, then run again.

out_of_memory.cause: The step{{step}} ran out of memory (or was killed for exceeding its resource limit){{exit}}.
out_of_memory.next: Re-run with a larger memory / instance size for that step, or reduce the input size (subset / downsample) so it fits.

container_tool.cause: A tool or container the step{{step}} needs was not available (missing command or image).
container_tool.next: This is usually an environment issue on our side — report it to BioMate; we will check the container/tool image for that step. Re-running as-is will not help until it is fixed.

missing_input_file.cause: An input file the pipeline needs could not be found at the path it was given.
missing_input_file.cause_named: An input the pipeline needs could not be found: {{file}}.
missing_input_file.next: Check that the file parameter points to a file that exists and is still accessible (re-upload or fix the path), then run again.
missing_input_file.next_named: Check that the file parameter points to a file that exists and is still accessible (re-upload or fix the path), then run again.

bad_parameter.cause: A parameter value was invalid, or a required parameter was missing.
bad_parameter.cause_named: A parameter value was invalid or missing: {{param}}.
bad_parameter.next: Open the workflow panel → Edit params, fix the named parameter (set a valid/allowed value), then run again.
bad_parameter.next_named: Open the workflow panel → Edit params, fix the named parameter (set a valid/allowed value), then run again.

tool_error.cause_named: The step{{step}} stopped with an error from the tool itself: {{detail}}
tool_error.next_named: Check the input and parameters against that message (it usually names what is wrong), fix them, then run again.
